sequences.title: Corte curto de katana — amostra diagnóstica
sequences.motion_contract: Body-driven short descending diagonal cut. Rear-leg load, hips/shoulders coil, front knee absorbs. Katana preserves normal model in all keys except owner-authorized R02 transient stretched/tapered down-right sweep. Longer preparation and low absorption, controlled return to original guard; no root translation.
